# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security or privacy issues privately to
[jack@veryjack.com](mailto:jack@veryjack.com) before opening a public Issue.

Include the affected version, reproduction steps, and expected impact. Do not
send real user images, passwords, access tokens, private keys, server logs with
personal data, or other sensitive material. A minimal synthetic test case is
preferred.

VeryPixel is maintained on a best-effort basis. Confirmed issues affecting the
current public version will be investigated and fixed as time permits.
